<!-- screenpipe — AI that knows everything you've seen, said, or heard -->

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

**Mission fit:** What user outcome does this serve? Why does it belong in HC or
an HC adapter? Which existing contract does it extend?

**Scope:** What is the smallest complete change? Explain any new module,
dependency, tool surface or external service and the simpler alternative.

**Evidence:** Relevant tests/evals and their results. Distinguish deterministic
checks, reviewer judgments and actual model trials. Name remaining limitations.

If this changes MISSION.md or the scope-eval policy/answers, explain that change
explicitly. A green scope job does not replace reviewing the actual diff.
